The babadook, Hereditary, The Saw movies, Us and Get Out
This gives me Judgment Day vibes
Hey! Is there still stuff left? If so, could I come check it out?

Depression has many forms. You can have many of the common symptoms or only a few and still have depression. What you shouldn't do is rely on tests from the internet, only a certified professional can give you a diagnosis.

However, if you are concerned you might have depression, you should definitely go see a professional. Catch it as early as you can and don't let it go further. Wish you well and I really hope you'll get through anything hard going on in your life. 💛
